result.topic_en: Rules for a bracket symbol (x, x'; y, y') attached to a segment between two points (behaviour under translation, swapping, sign change and exchange of coordinates, with [ ] apparently the integer part), with sketches of trapezoids and triangles and a computation of a trapezoid area after rotating the axes by 45°.

methods.what: Invariance of the bracket symbol under a horizontal translation of both points
methods.quote: 1 $\begin{pmatrix} x+a, & x'+a \\ y, & y' \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} x, & x' \\ y, & y' \end{pmatrix}$

methods.what: Change of the bracket symbol under a vertical translation by b, involving the bracket (integer-part) terms
methods.quote: 2. $\begin{pmatrix} x, & x' \\ y+b, & y'+b \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} x, & x' \\ y, & y' \end{pmatrix} + b[y'] - b[y]$

methods.what: Antisymmetry under exchanging the two points
methods.quote: 3. $\begin{pmatrix} x', & x \\ y', & y \end{pmatrix} = -\begin{pmatrix} x, & x' \\ y, & y' \end{pmatrix}$
4 $\begin{pmatrix} -x, & -x' \\ y, & y' \end{pmatrix} = -\begin{pmatrix} x, & x' \\ y, & y' \end{pmatrix}$
5. $\begin{pmatrix} x, & x' \\ -y, & -y' \end{pmatrix} = -\begin{pmatrix} x, & x' \\ y, & y' \end{pmatrix}$

methods.what: Reciprocity relation: the symbol plus the symbol with x and y exchanged equals a difference of products of bracket (integer-part) terms
methods.quote: 6 $\begin{pmatrix} y, & y' \\ x, & x' \end{pmatrix} + \begin{pmatrix} x, & x' \\ y, & y' \end{pmatrix} = [x'][y'] - [x][y]$
